Cookies and settings

This site collects no personal data and has no tracking or ads. It only remembers your settings: favorites, filters and the panel layout. Nothing is stored until you choose.

Essential: your settings are kept in cookies in this browser only. Google sign-in stays off.

All: cookies, plus Google sign-in to keep the same settings in your account and sync them between devices. The account is used only for that (Google's sign-in keeps your name and e-mail to identify it). Change it any time under "Cookie settings" at the bottom of the page.
